title: India's net FDI inflows falls to $3 billion in August
description: Gross foreign direct investment (FDI) to India decreased to $11 billion in August, from $14 billion a month ago. Net FDI to India slows $3 billion in August, from $7 billion in July. Financial services, communication services, computer services and manufacturing accounted for around 73% of total FDI equity inflows during April-August 2026.

title: Swiggy sinks 16% to record low as quick-commerce losses widen
description: Shares of Swiggy fell by 16.4% to ₹176.70, marking a record low for the company. This decline raises concerns over cash burn and achieving profitability in its quick-commerce business. Analysts are questioning Swiggy's strategic choices and execution following its market debut. The widening losses in the quick-commerce segment have drawn attention to the company's overall performance.

title: BSE begins hunt for MD & CEO successor ahead of 2027 exit
description: BSE has initiated the search for its next managing director and chief executive officer. Sundararaman Ramamurthy is scheduled to retire in June 2027 after reaching the age limit. The exchange is looking for candidates with at least 20 years of experience, which includes senior leadership roles. Applicants need to be under 62 years old as of July 1, 2027.

title: IndusInd Bank posts Rs 1,242 crore net profit on lower provisions
description: IndusInd Bank reported an impressive consolidated net profit of ₹1,242 crore for the September quarter, marking a robust recovery from the previous year's loss of ₹437 crore. This turnaround stems from decreased provisions and heightened fee income, alongside encouraging trends in asset quality, evidenced by reduced non-performing asset ratios. The bank's financial outlook showcases a significant improvement in both growth and profitability.

title: Infosys upbeat on deals, cautious on growth as competition intensifies
description: Infosys released its quarterly results, showing good revenue growth and stable operating margins. However, the management reduced the annual revenue guidance due to competitive pressures. The company secured a significant $2 billion deal, boosting its total contract value to $5.2 billion. Despite positive performance from some sectors, weaknesses in others contributed to the cautious outlook. The market response led to a rise in the stock price, affecting valuation metrics.
